successors.name: Ajuran Sultanate
successors.text: Mogadishu, "the centre"; Merca and Barawa served with it as transit stops for Swahili merchants

ledger.x: Mid-13th century: the sultanate of Mogadishu.
Late 16th century: the Fakhr al-Din dynasty ends.

wars.name: Portuguese attack on Mogadishu
wars.outcome: "In 1542, a Portuguese expedition under João de Sepúlveda attacked the city", which "compelled the sultan of Mogadishu to sign a peace treaty with the Portuguese".

certainty.note: A city-state; no territory is described.
